[{"relname":"admin_play_billing_status","reloptions":["security_invoker=true"],"anon_select":false,"auth_select":true,"definition":" SELECT p.id AS product_id,\n    p.title,\n    p.price,\n    p.active AS catalog_active,\n        CASE\n            WHEN NOT p.active THEN 'catalog_inactive'::text\n            WHEN NOT play_notes_product_eligible(p.*) THEN 'not_billable_notes'::text\n            WHEN p.price <= 0::numeric THEN 'unsupported_price'::text\n            WHEN t.verified_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND t.active AND s.status = 'ready'::text THEN 'ready'::text\n            WHEN s.status = 'ready'::text THEN 'stale'::text\n            ELSE COALESCE(s.status, 'pending'::text)\n        END AS billing_status,\n    t.play_sku,\n    t.purchase_option_id,\n    t.price_inr AS synced_price,\n    t.currency_code,\n    s.last_synced_at,\n    s.last_error,\n    s.attempts\n   FROM products p\n     LEFT JOIN play_price_sync s ON s.price_inr = p.price\n     LEFT JOIN play_price_tiers t ON t.play_sku = s.candidate_sku AND t.active AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL\n  WHERE am_i_admin();"},{"relname":"payment_queue_metrics","reloptions":null,"anon_select":false,"auth_select":false,"definition":" SELECT kind,\n    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text])) AS backlog_count,\n    min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text])) AS oldest_queued_at,\n    min(deadline_at) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text])) AS oldest_deadline_at,\n    ceil(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text]))::numeric / 40::numeric) * 60::numeric AS estimated_drain_seconds,\n    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'parked'::text) AS parked_count\n   FROM payment_jobs\n  GROUP BY kind;"},{"relname":"play_recovery_metrics","reloptions":null,"anon_select":false,"auth_select":false,"definition":" SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count\n           FROM play_payment_jobs\n          WHERE play_payment_jobs.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text])) AS backlog_count,\n    ( SELECT count(*) AS count\n           FROM play_payment_jobs\n          WHERE play_payment_jobs.status = 'parked'::text) AS parked_count,\n    ( SELECT min(play_payment_jobs.created_at) AS min\n           FROM play_payment_jobs\n          WHERE play_payment_jobs.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text])) AS oldest_job_at,\n    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()) * 1000::numeric - end_time_ms::numeric) / 1000::numeric AS cursor_lag_seconds,\n    attempts AS cursor_failures,\n    last_error AS cursor_error\n   FROM play_recovery_cursor c\n  WHERE id = true;"},{"relname":"play_void_sweep_metrics","reloptions":null,"anon_select":false,"auth_select":false,"definition":" SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count\n           FROM orders o\n          WHERE o.provider = 'play'::text AND o.status = 'paid'::text AND (o.play_last_checked_at IS NULL OR o.play_last_checked_at < (now() - '02:00:00'::interval))) AS unchecked_count,\n    ( SELECT min(COALESCE(o.play_last_checked_at, o.created_at)) AS min\n           FROM orders o\n          WHERE o.provider = 'play'::text AND o.status = 'paid'::text) AS oldest_unchecked_at,\n    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()) * 1000::numeric - end_time_ms::numeric) / 1000::numeric AS cursor_lag_seconds,\n    updated_at AS cursor_updated_at\n   FROM play_void_sweep_state s\n  WHERE id = true;"}]
